text: so sorry to message so late, it's probably nothing and I feel bad taking up your time. my stepson is 3 months old and his temp is 38.3, I checked it twice. he's got a few little insect bites on his arm that look itchy, he keeps rubbing at them. also before anyone panics about the purple round his mouth, that's blackcurrant juice, his big sister was giving him sticky kisses after her drink and it's all over his chin and lips, it comes off on a wipe, I tested a bit. I just wasn't sure what to do about the temperature at his age. sorry again
